name: Jinshan Temple
note: Buddhist temple complex on Jinshan Hill in Jinshan Park, with a lake, paddle boats and the White Snake legend setting.

name: Jiaoshan
note: Island hill park in the Yangtze with Dinghui Temple, a large pagoda, the Stele Forest and a peacock farm.

name: Beigu Hill
note: Hill park on the Yangtze bank, one of Zhenjiang's three famous hills, with temples, towers and river views.

name: Ganlu Temple
note: Buddhist temple on Beigu Hill known for its Iron Pagoda, a sub-site of the Beigu Hill visit.

name: Beigu Tower
note: Tower on Beigu Hill overlooking the Yangtze, a sub-site of the Beigu Hill visit.

name: Duojing Tower
note: Tower on Beigu Hill with river views, a sub-site of the Beigu Hill visit.

name: Nanshan Park
coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (Wikivoyage Zhenjiang, Nanshan Park)
note: Hill park south of the city with paths up the hill and a large pagoda at the top giving city and river views.

name: Zhulin Temple
coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (Wikivoyage Zhenjiang, Zhulin Temple)
note: Buddhist temple in a bamboo valley beneath Zhaoyin Mountain, reached through a forest of bamboo.

name: Helin Temple
note: Buddhist temple in the Zhenjiang hills, named in a commercial guide's list of local temples (location to confirm).

name: Xijindu Ancient Street
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=theme_park 西津渡历史文化街区
note: Restored medieval Yangtze ferry crossing with old streets, shops and preserved buildings in Jingkou District.

name: Zhenjiang Museum
note: City museum in Zhenjiang, free to enter, covering the history of the region.

name: Zhenjiang Vinegar Culture Museum
coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (Wikivoyage Zhenjiang, China Vinegar Culture Museum)
note: Museum in Dantu District dedicated to Zhenjiang vinegar, the city's famous product, with a 4,000 m2 exhibition space.

name: Former British Consulate in Zhenjiang
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum 镇江英国领事馆旧址区
note: Nineteenth-century British consulate and staff houses on Yuntai Mountain in Xijindu, a Major National heritage site.

name: Pearl S. Buck Former Residence
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 赛珍珠纪念馆
note: Former home of the American writer Pearl S. Buck in Zhenjiang, now a memorial museum.

name: Gospel Church, Zhenjiang
note: Protestant church built by Methodist missionaries in 1889 on Daxi Road, a heritage building judged on its interior.

name: Shanxiang Mosque
note: Mosque in Runzhou District dating from 1662, an active Islamic site with a school history.

name: Gao Mausoleum
note: Mound-shaped tomb of the Three Kingdoms war leader Sun Jian, 18 m high, near Dafen Village.

name: Mount Mao
note: Taoist mountain in Jurong (372 m) with a one-hour climb, holy sites and a Taoist cultural heritage area.

name: Longchang Temple
note: Vinaya Buddhist temple on Mount Baohua in Jurong, known for its Copper Hall and Beamless Halls.

name: Gexian Lake Park
note: Urban park in central Jurong built around a lake and named for the Eastern Jin Taoist Ge Hong.

name: Wanshan Park
note: Garden park in Danyang with pavilions, bridges and a 47.8 m seven-storey brick pagoda built in 1627.

name: Jizi Temple
coordinates_source: OSM place_of_worship 季子庙-慈航殿
note: Temple in Danyang honouring the sage Jizi, with the Boiling Wells, Shizi Monument and historic bridges.

name: Kaitai Bridge
note: Historic stone arch bridge in Danyang from the Wanli era, a short look at a crossing in the old town.

name: Yangzhong Land Park
note: Leisure and entertainment park on Yangzhong's second island, the city's main tourist park.

name: Yangzhong Pufferfish Sculpture
note: Giant bronze pufferfish statue in Yangzhong, a city known for pufferfish cuisine (location not yet confirmed).

name: Xining Destroyer Museum Ship
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 西宁号导弹驱逐舰
note: Decommissioned missile destroyer open to visitors as a museum ship at Yangzhong, moored with other warships.

name: Chuanshan Scenic Area
note: Scenic hill in Yangzhong with a memorial pagoda (Baoen Pagoda) and walking paths.

name: Gaoqiao Finless Porpoise Bay
other_sources: https://www.openstreetmap.org/search?query=江苏镇江长江豚类省级自然保护区
note: Yangtze finless porpoise reserve and viewing area on the river at Gaoqiao, Zhenjiang, for seeing the rare river dolphin.

name: Shiye Island
note: Yangtze island with a grassland park, reached in the Dantu area, named in OSM with a Chinese Wikipedia link.

name: Dajin Mountain National Defence Park
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=theme_park 大金山国防园
note: Military history and defence park on Dajin Mountain in Jurong (scenic and museum; location to confirm).

name: Changshan Lavender Rainbow Town
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=theme_park 长山薰衣草彩虹小镇
note: Themed village with lavender fields and a dinosaur museum in Zhenjiang's Dantu area (seasonal flowers, year-round attractions).
